caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white, depicting two main objects. On the left, there is an old-fashioned candlestick telephone consisting of a round, flared base supporting a vertical cylindrical shaft with a curved handle at the side. At the top of the shaft, the mouthpiece is attached, and above the mouthpiece, a hinged cap is open, held by a small chain. To the right of the telephone and resting on the surface is a large, conical horn speaker, positioned on its side with the open end facing outward and the narrower end toward the telephone, which would typically attach to the device. The illustration is done in pencil or ink, showing shading and textural details on both objects. The background is plain and unembellished, with the artist's signature visible near the lower right of the horn speaker.
title: Pewter Lamp
